recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5268 unless the work group opens a new clarification about self-employed practitioners and PractitionerRole.organization.
issue_request: FHIR-5268 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Administration ballot clarification for Practitioner. It requested removal of the note saying Practitioner.organization is optional and can represent self-employed professionals because absence of an Organization should not imply self-employment.
initial_application: Commit 8ed9982708ac31ba37ad6670f9be8ba628634329 explicitly listed tracker 5268, removed the exact first Notes bullet with the self-employed wording from practitioner-notes.xml, and moved practitioner organization/role modeling away from Practitioner.organization into the role structure used at that time.
additional_context: Practitioner and PractitionerRole are active resources in the current build. Current Practitioner notes do not contain the removed self-employment note, current Practitioner has no Practitioner.organization element, and current PractitionerRole.organization is the role-specific organization relationship. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence or later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested clarification is already represented by the absence of the obsolete note in current source, and adding redundant new prose would not improve current implementer guidance.
